candidates.name: healing-agent
notes: Catches exceptions and generates repair suggestions.
Uses backups before code modification, making it a natural baseline for Aether snapshot rollback.
Small enough for a first integration experiment.

candidates.name: RepairAgent
notes: Heavier setup because it depends on Java and Defects4J.
Useful after the Aether self-healing adapter is proven on smaller systems.

candidates.name: distil-self-healing-agent
notes: Useful for studying telemetry, diagnosis, and remediation handoff.
May require provider credentials and local service setup.

candidates.name: Self-Healing-SRE-Agent
notes: Useful for multi-agent incident repair and validation.
Best after low-level mutation safety is already demonstrated.
